headline: She Was Going Into Labor. But She Had a Bar Exam to Finish.
snippet: Brianna Hill, who gave birth to a baby boy between sections of the exam, has earned kudos for determination. But some law school graduates say her story points to flaws with the testing system amid the pandemic.

headline: Google Employees Are Free to Speak Up. Except on Antitrust.
snippet: A company operating in the shadow of government regulators has some very particular rules about what workers can say about it.
